fields.statement: Intent narrowed (plan review f3): release tooling is for this repo only (@{01M76BBTW1A3C00G0VYQ1WBTKA}), so the marks are notes on change sets read by tools/release (@{01M76B7DJ5HD25ETA8QRYQP9GA}), not fields of rhiza requests. A severe fix is marked by a severe: note on its change set, not a severity on the bug request, and the rhiza build a bug was filed against is not recorded on the request. The soak gate (@release-gates) instead counts any bug request filed since the root daemon first ran the candidate commit, which is conservative: every such bug was filed against that commit or a later one.
